decision: held: none of the three sources has open full text (no PMC records). The OA trial 18386255 abstract gives dose (100 mg/day capsules), duration (3 months) and arms (77 vs 79) but does not designate a primary outcome, comparator co-medication handling or randomization details, so rule 2's primary-outcome requirement cannot be verified; the two blood-pressure/cardiometabolic meta-analyses (31637782, 31585179) give no regimens or included-trial lists. No context can be completed without invention. OA retry 2026-10-28: only 31585179 has an open copy (figshare submitted version); 18386255 and 31637782 closed, so the OA trial cannot be completed.
summary: 18386255 (SVOS): 156 knee-OA patients, Pycnogenol 100 mg/day for 3 months; global WOMAC fell 56% versus 9.6% on placebo, walking distance and NSAID use improved. 31637782: 12 trials (922 participants), SBP -3.22 and DBP -1.91 mmHg, larger when combined with other treatments. 31585179: 24 RCTs (1594 participants), small improvements in glucose, HbA1c, BP, BMI, LDL and HDL. Effects are modest and the OA evidence rests on one trial.
